set.body: Extend native NiftiStagingLimits with aggregate cache bytes and public usage inspection; serialize publication at cache root so multiple distinct images cannot race a shared budget. Count existing entries and temporary expansion, preserve valid entries on refusal. Desktop owns per-study cache lifetime and settings; it must not infer quota by parsing native filenames. Verify two different concurrent compressed sources, exact-limit reuse, cleanup on refusal; dataset JVM/JS. Consumer plsneuro bd-01M1VMCXJ9ZRHSA9B0FX60VEGP.
set.title: Enforce aggregate staging quota across concurrent images
